results/addressing/snapshot/addressing-p.text:
# Memory addressing and small-set diagnostic

Authorized continuation of the failed delta-memory pilot. Diagnose the existing learned controller before changing the architecture. Do not modify model.py, associative.py, config, training or inference math. No fresh held-out claims or new model-test scoring.

1. New src/mlm/addressing.py traces a prompt through the actual model one input byte at a time, beginning with BOS. From the actual returned graph state, independently reconstruct base pooling and learned key/query/value/write gate, old-matrix read, updated matrix and normalized output logits. Validate against actual state/logits and full-prompt uninstrumented forward to float32 tolerance. The helper accepts only prompt text and frozen neural state/config; no facts/expected answers. Padding is not used by this prompt-only tracer.
2. Exact conditional read decomposition: with A_j=I−beta_j k_j k_jᵀ, r_t=sum_{s<t} beta_s(q_tᵀ A_{t-1}...A_{s+1}k_s)v_s. Compute coefficients by traversing writes backward and propagating q through each symmetric A. Exclude current/future writes. Coefficients are signed, not probabilities; raw cosine is not an overwrite-aware attribution. Compare reconstructed recall vector against actual old-matrix read.
3. Trace first8 training questions (the first full assignment/query/order case) from data/kv-binding-v1/diverse on the failed full-pilot delta checkpoint and its saved initial-delta checkpoint. Fixed selection, no cherry-picking. Offline canonical-fact regions annotate writes after inference: BOS/header/fact1/fact2/question/assistant header. Validate every byte is covered. Report mean write gates, sums of absolute/signed effective coefficients and projected contribution norms per region; these are conditional diagnostics, not causal proof of where knowledge lives. Compare query/read vectors across fixed-context query swaps. Fact metadata never enters the model/tracer.
4. Frozen readout ablation: copy params in memory, set only memory_gain=0, no retraining. Score all512 original pilot training questions with unchanged neural scorer and full English development32 stories. Compare prediction flips, correct-choice score margins, complete-group rankings, answer-only training NLL and English loss. Original checkpoints/config/data remain unchanged. This disables memory output, not writes or compute. It diagnoses coadapted channel dependence, not architectural superiority. No changed test answers, generated repairs or inference parser.
5. Independent source-matched probes: graph versus delta on one training group and four training groups, taking the first4/16 original training records/questions. Four groups cover the same entity pair with two complementary color pairs and both fact orders. Every trial resets from the same original English-only checkpoint, never from the failed pilot or another probe, with fresh optimizer, same split rates/seed42,500 QA +500 English rehearsal updates (four trials total4,000 optimizer updates). One-group exposure500, four-group exposure125 per group. Tiny validation is the first8 complete conditions from the old pilot's validation pool; no test files are created or opened. It is an exploratory debug set, not confirmation.
6. For each trained delta probe, trace its fixed first training group, and repeat readout ablation on its training set and English development. Include baseline probe train/English results. Save all sources/initial fingerprints/sampler traces/counters/config/environment/checkpoints/raw scores. Fixed endpoints, no sweeps or checkpoint promotion. Test math, actual-forward reconstruction, exclusion of future/current writes, region coverage and ablation immutability. Reuse existing tested plasticity_run; add no training/inference behavior changes. Independent review and regression/static checks before freezing.

Freeze prior checkpoint/data/config and all relevant code hashes before diagnosis/training. Outputs results/addressing/report.md +summary.json +traces and source/test/config/lock snapshots; update research.md/prd.md/README/data notes. Preserve frozen plan and all prior model artifacts. A fitted tiny training set cannot demonstrate general binding. Finite-budget failure cannot prove capacity limits. Further changes selected from these diagnostics need fresh confirmation.

data/evaluation/README.md.text:
# Reading probes v1

Original evaluation-only diagnostic: 12 pairs / 24 questions. Each pair keeps the question and candidate answers fixed while changing a context fact and the correct answer. The expected-answer key only grades frozen-model likelihood rankings. It is never passed to the network or used for training, checkpoint selection, or inference response rules. No regex or response-keyword classifier is used.

Report individual accuracy, both-members-correct pair accuracy, and prediction-change fraction. A fixed answer preference gets 50% item accuracy and zero pair accuracy on this balanced set. Two-choice guessing has 50% expected item accuracy. This tiny authored set is not a standardized general-understanding benchmark. Mean answer-byte likelihood can still favor particular strings; paired results help expose that bias but do not eliminate all confounds.

Use identical prompt format for comparisons. Chat-formatted results for a dialogue-adapted checkpoint belong to a separate comparison because its training and prompt format differ. Freeze this v1 suite before inspecting results; future revisions must get a new version rather than silently changing questions.


Scorer version 2 conditions on `Answer: ` in plain format or the assistant-marker newline in chat format. It scores only the answer bytes, excluding those prompt separators from the numerator and denominator. Preliminary version-1 scores that included an extra space are retained as superseded artifacts; the question-suite hash is unchanged.
